_comment: Which outgoing-damage percent modifiers share GW2's single ADDITIVE bucket. Everything not listed is a separate multiplicative factor (wiki Damage_calculation: 'The majority of damage multipliers combine in a multiplicative fashion ... However, some sigils, traits, and effects from utility skills stack additively with each other'). The game displays nothing about this; membership is a tested fact per effect, not a rule. Names are GW2 API display names. Effects with an additive and a multiplicative half (Superior Sigil of Impact 3%+7%, Unscathed Contender) are listed because the unconditional half is the additive one; the conditional half is parsed into deferred_target (Impact's 7% sits behind the Disabled gate) and is applied at resolve time, not folded into this bucket.
sources: https://github.com/discretize/discretize-gear-optimizer/tree/main/src/assets/modifierdata (per-effect in-game tests, read 2026-09-07 at commit b64d724; facts only, no data copied)
